lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the five vertical gill slits, forming near-linear horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a matrix-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-intensity white patch is visible on the dorsal surface posterior to the head and superior to the first gill slit; a minor notch is visible on the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of small, irregularly distributed high-luminance spots is visible on the dorsal cranial region anterior to the gill slits.
